page_title: RMA 5-0 ALA | Real Madrid v Alaves 14/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Mateo Busquets Ferrer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Luis Rioja (Alaves) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Thibaut Courtois.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Luis Rioja (Alaves) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but the keeper dives and denies him.

89' Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Thibaut Courtois was alert and the score remains the same.
87' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
86' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
86' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
86' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Jesus Owono makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
82' Here's the change. Federico Valverde leaves the pitch and Mario Martin (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
81' 5 - 0 Goal! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 5:0.
81' A great run by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
80' It looks like Abdel Abqar (Alaves) saw red with that tackle. Mateo Busquets Ferrer won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
79' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

78' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
78' Substitution. Samu Omorodion leaves the pitch and is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
77' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
77' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.

76' What a save from Thibaut Courtois! Samu Omorodion (Alaves) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
74' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Jesus Owono anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.

73' Luis Rioja (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toni Kroos departs the field of play to be replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
72' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) replacing Eder Militao.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ianis Hagi as he is replaced by Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves).
70' 4 - 0 Goal Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid)! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) was put through by Jude Bellingham and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top left corner. 4:0.
69' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer who sees an offensive foul.
68' The attendance is 68954.
65' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
64' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
62' Here comes a substitution. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Eduardo Camavinga.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Guridi (Alaves) comes onto the pitch for Ander Guevara.
62' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Alex Sola and he is replaced by Xeber Alkain (Alaves).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andoni Gorosabel trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
61' What a chance that is! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
61' A pass finds the feet of Ianis Hagi (Alaves) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
60' 1:1 – the corner kicks stats.
58' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Jesus Owono makes a great save to stop his effort.
58' Alex Sola (Alaves) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
57' A nice lofted cross finds Ianis Hagi (Alaves) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!

56' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
56' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Jesus Owono. What a save!
55' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
54' Alex Sola (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
52' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
51' The free kick into the penalty area from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is cleared.
50' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Ruben Duarte (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
49' Real Madrid string together a series of short passes.
47' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Mateo Busquets Ferrer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Samu Omorodion (Alaves).
45+3' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

45+1' 3 - 0 Goal! Jude Bellingham finds Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the top right corner. Fantasy football! 3:0.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jesus Owono easily deals with the threat.
44' Flag up against Samu Omorodion (Alaves). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
44' The ball possession at the moment is 76:24.
41' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
39' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) takes a mid-range free kick and fires the ball into the stands. His effort flew well wide of the right post and it's going to be a goal kick.
39' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Ander Guevara (Alaves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.

37' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the left post, but is stopped by a great save from Thibaut Courtois and the score remains the same.
35' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
35' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
34' The referee blows his whistle as Eder Militao (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
32' Real Madrid keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
30' Dangerous play by Ianis Hagi (Alaves). Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
29' A pass from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Jesus Owono and the move breaks down.
27' 2 - 0 Goal! Eduardo Camavinga puts the ball on a plate for Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:0.
25' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
24' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul after Ruben Duarte (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
21' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

20' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
18' The total number of attempts is 1:4.
17' A pass from Alex Sola (Alaves) is intercepted by Thibaut Courtois and the move breaks down.
16' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets Ferrer no option but to blow his whistle.
15' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) is adjudged offside.
14' Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
13' Real Madrid hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

10' 1 - 0 Toni Kroos sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot which hits the right post and bounces in off it. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
9' Rafa Marin (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
8' The foul by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) was seen by Mateo Busquets Ferrer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
7' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
6' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

2' Thibaut Courtois pulls off a great save to deny Samu Omorodion (Alaves), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
